name: Gallia Cyrano
source: A tomboyish girl, with an interest in tank warfare and freedom. She believes strongly that Franzo has a unique destiny, as a long-time enemy of Germania. A fierce fighter and a loyal patriot, she hates losing, even in small matters like board games. Enjoys running and going to the theatre (although most of them were closed due to the war). Despite her athletic lifestyle, she still smokes cigarettes - a habit she refuses to give up.
